summary: A strict black-and-white brand page for a paper maker's corporate sans: a WebGL hero of real paper sheets, then large-text story, a video of sliced letterforms, a tidy tester and a character set with a hover preview. Its special quality is how little there is: paper-white, one typeface, generous space.

instances.look: Full-screen grey paper still life: a blank white sheet tilted over a printed sheet with a rotated manifesto and 'This is Munken / CoLab / Sans'; the giant 'A TILL Ö' peeks up from below the fold. A cookie bar covers the bottom of the capture
instances.ux: No CTA. The sheets are rendered in a WebGL canvas that fades in on load (blank until t≈1.5s, then settles); scrolling leaves it behind
instances.learn: For a paper brand, render the hero as lit paper with real shadows and displacement: the font's first appearance is as ink on the client's product

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×900 canvas, image inset from x≈150 to the right edge and from y≈70; printed sheet ~340×560px right of centre, rotated ~4°, its text turned 90°; blank sheet ~430px square rotated about 35° overlapping it; fixed logo bar above
reconstruction.typography: Printed text ~20px Munken Sans Regular, rotated, sentence case; 3-line sign-off in the corner
reconstruction.behaviour: WebGL scene built from textures (background, paper, shadow and displacement maps listed in data-textures); .l-paper-hero--anim plays a settle-in on load. Whether it reacts to the pointer is not visible in the capture
reconstruction.content: 'Collaboration, diversity and encounters form the roots of creativity…', 'This is Munken, This is Munken CoLab, This is Munken Sans'
reconstruction.assets: Photographed background, paper textures with shadow and displacement maps
